q1.sampleAnswer: They were talking about the difference clean water had made in their community.

keyPoints.descZh: 他们在谈清洁的水给社区带来的变化
examples: the difference clean water had made in their community

q1.rubricZh: 要点：清洁水给社区带来的变化。
q1.explanationZh: 第二段说村民们很想聊清洁的水给他们的社区带来了什么不同。

evidence.quote: These people were eager to talk about the difference clean water had made in their community.

q2.sampleAnswer: It had enabled her to have better health and spend more time in school, allowing her to become better educated than many of her fellow villagers.

keyPoints.descZh: 她身体更健康、在学校的时间更多
她比很多同村人受教育更好
examples: become better educated than many of her fellow villagers

q2.rubricZh: 要点：更健康、上学时间更多；因此比同村人受过更好的教育（两点缺一不可）。
q2.explanationZh: 第三段说有了清洁的水，Natalia 更健康，能多上学，所以比村里很多人受教育更好。

evidence.quote: Access to clean water had enabled her to have better health.

q3.sampleAnswer: Because they have no access to clean water and have to drink dirty water.

keyPoints.descZh: 他们没有清洁的水，只能喝脏水
examples: have no access to clean water

q3.rubricZh: 要点：没有清洁水，喝脏水。
q3.explanationZh: 倒数第二段说这些人没有清洁的水，要把脏水带回家喝，所以常常胃痛。

evidence.quote: They carry dirty water all the way home and serve it to the people they love most.

q4.sampleAnswer: We can donate to organisations that provide clean water solutions and save water in our own lives. (Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 第一种合理办法（如捐款给提供清洁水的机构）
examples: donate to organisations that provide clean water solutions

keyPoints.descZh: 第二种合理办法（如自己节约用水）
examples: save water in our own lives

q4.rubricZh: 开放题：写出两种合理的帮助办法即可，各得 1 分。
q4.explanationZh: 这是开放题。写出两种可行的办法，比如捐款给提供清洁水的组织，或在生活中节约用水。

q5.explanationZh: 空前有 personal（个人的），后面要名词。serve 的名词是 service（服务）。

q6.explanationZh: 空在句首作主语，要用名词。educated 的名词是 education（教育），首字母大写。

q7.explanationZh: filled her with 后面要名词。proudly 对应的名词是 pride（骄傲）。

q8.explanationZh: Doctors are 后面要形容词表示“担心的”，be worried about 担心。

q9.explanationZh: was ... with people 表示“挤满了人”，用形容词 crowded。

q10.explanationZh: 空在名词 medical attention 前，要用形容词 immediate（立即的）。

q11.explanationZh: 画线部分 Access to clean water 是主语，问“什么”用 What；句子是过去完成时，所以接 had enabled her。

q12.explanationZh: 前面是肯定句，反意疑问部分用否定：wouldn’t it？主语是动名词短语，用 it 代替。

q13.explanationZh: 直接引语要用一般现在时的疑问句：What do you expect of your daughter’s future？she 变成 you，her 变成 your。
q13.tipsZh: 间接引语变直接引语：人称和时态都要改

q14.explanationZh: 画线部分 that water is life 是 told 的宾语，问“什么”用 What；过去的事用 did，后面动词变回原形 tell。

q15.explanationZh: 主语 local people，副词 constantly 放在动词前，suffer from 后接 this type of disease：Local people constantly suffer from this type of disease。
